page.content:
Sky-father, thunderer, and king of the Olympian gods.

How Zeus connects

  • Location: Mount Olympus — Zeus rules the Olympian court on Mount Olympus.
  • Character: Athena — Athena was born from Zeus's head.
  • Faction: Titans — Zeus overthrew the Titans and bound them below.
  • Character: Prometheus — Prometheus stole fire and was punished by Zeus.
  • Character: Hera — Hera is Zeus's queen and partner in Olympian rule.
  • Character: Pandora — Zeus ordered Pandora made as the price of stolen fire.
  • Character: Poseidon — Zeus and Poseidon divided sky and sea after the Titans fell.
  • Character: Hades — Zeus and Hades divided sky and Underworld after the Titans fell.
  • Character: Hephaestus — Hephaestus smiths the thunderbolts Zeus hurls.

What is Zeus?

Zeus overthrew Cronus, divided the cosmos with his brothers, and rules from Olympus. His thunderbolt, many liaisons, and judgments shape both divine and heroic myth.

Key threads lead to Mount Olympus, Athena, Titans, Prometheus, Hera and Pandora.
